name: g-mm-repair: A Memory-Bounded GPU Engine for Right Multiplication over Grammar-Compressed Matrices
description: A high-performance level-synchronous GPU engine (CUDA C++) for computing the right matrix-vector product y = Mx over RePair grammar-compressed matrices. It uses a double-buffered level sweep with an emit-on-the-spot memory optimization and supports the PlusTimes, Boolean, and Tropical semirings, applied to genotype matrices and knowledge-graph relations.
